title: Terminalize a missing Calibration original from S3

verify.summary: Fresh independent T3 verification proved the supported S3 NoSuchKey missing-original path terminalizes the claimed Calibration run as failed/dataset_unavailable with finished_at, releases the existing singleton worker, preserves serving state, permits queued Photo progress and creates no replacement run. Other ClientError values rethrow unchanged; no serving/startup, scheduler, queue, retry, registry or worker-topology change was observed.

evidence_required: FT-011-AC-005 and .memory-bank/domains/calibration.md#immutable-input-and-evaluation RED: an isolated claimed Calibration run whose selected original read raises the supported PrivateObjectStore S3 ClientError with Error.Code=NoSuchKey escapes the offline input boundary and remains running after the singleton worker releases; GREEN: the identical isolated read records exactly terminal failed/dataset_unavailable with finished_at, releases the existing worker to idle, lets queued Photo work proceed, preserves the committed serving revision and startup adapter, and creates no replacement Calibration run; decisive comparison: a focused fake PrivateObjectStore reproduces the real NoSuchKey response through execute_claimed before and after the repair, snapshots run/worker/Photo/serving state, and retains redacted focused test output under .tasks/TASK-111-T3-FT-011-W2/.
purpose: Act as the sole active replacement owner of FT-011-AC-005's proved missing-original terminalization gap, without retrying failed TASK-101 or changing the shared-worker design.
success_outcome: A supported S3 NoSuchKey for a frozen Calibration original becomes the existing terminal dataset_unavailable failure, then the singleton worker releases for ordinary Photo work with no automatic rerun or serving change.
anti_goals: Do not reopen, retry, relabel or alter the failed TASK-101 evidence.
Do not change adapter binding order, serving/startup binding, worker scheduling, Photo processing semantics or object-store behavior outside the Calibration read failure mapping.
Do not add a registry, worker, queue, retry policy, fallback, upload, serving switch or broad object-store exception layer.

forbidden_scope: Production worker/processes, operator/default Calibration/Photo rows and real participant data
Serving-control state, startup adapter selection, model assets and ordinary Photo-processing algorithm/publication behavior
New worker services, scheduler state, priority/preemption, automatic Calibration rerun, registry or object-store framework changes
stop_conditions: The supported NoSuchKey cannot be converted at the existing offline Calibration input boundary without changing PrivateObjectStore's general contract or adding a new error framework.
The correction requires a second worker, replacement run, automatic retry, serving switch, preload or model registry.
The proof cannot use an isolated deterministic ClientError fixture, safe rerun and complete cleanup.

constraints: Map only the supported missing-object S3 ClientError at the existing offline Calibration input boundary to CalibrationDatasetUnavailableError; unexpected storage failures remain observable and unchanged.
Reuse the existing diagnostics-owned failed/dataset_unavailable transition and BackgroundPhotoWorker release path.
Use an isolated deterministic NoSuchKey fixture and prove safe rerun, worker release and queued Photo progress without production state.
invariants: A frozen selected dataset never silently shrinks, rebuilds or uploads a replacement original.
The missing-original path leaves a claimed run terminal and never triggers a replacement Calibration run.
Calibration remains test-only: the committed serving revision and normal startup binding are unchanged.
TASK-111 is the sole active replacement owner of FT-011-AC-005; TASK-101 retains only immutable failed historical ownership and evidence.
verification_targets: A fresh isolated PrivateObjectStore-compatible ClientError(NoSuchKey) fixture reaches execute_claimed and proves failed/dataset_unavailable plus finished_at rather than a durable running run.
The same focused worker fixture proves release to idle, subsequent queued Photo progress, zero automatic replacement runs, unchanged serving revision and unchanged normal startup adapter binding.

Focused source inspection proves the correction is the existing offline Calibration failure mapping only: no worker, scheduler, registry, preload, serving-switch, retry or broad object-store behavior is added.
